findings.target: te.completion-advice-lint — components.json after_integration.claim_corrections vs proposals.md Section 7 Revision 3
findings.finding: The component ledger (revision 2) states in its claim_corrections that the skip-advice heuristic 'stays a warning under --strict so existing strict wikis do not start failing on a guess,' but proposals.md Revision 3 (Section 7, item 7) explicitly withdraws that position: the warning becomes an error under --strict, consistent with HOLLOW_PHRASES behavior and the original absorb-9 body text ('在 strict 模式下會變成錯誤'). An implementer reading only components.json would implement the wrong behavior.
findings.evidence: components.json te.completion-advice-lint after_integration.claim_corrections: 'lint --strict turns warnings into errors (oaw-ref/scripts/wiki_sync.py:842-855); this heuristic family stays a warning under --strict.' Proposals.md Section 7: '修訂 3（goldfish-1 #7）：在 `--strict` 下和其他軟性警告一樣變成錯誤…修訂 2 的「仍只是警告」撤回'. Proposals.md absorb-9 body: '`lint --strict` 多了一類警告，在 strict 模式下會變成錯誤'. Embedded wiki_sync.py:848-849 confirms: 'if strict: issues.extend(warnings)'.

review.summary: The packet is internally well-supported: all 13 absorb citations that are embedded check out, all flagged integration items have documented fixes or are appropriately demoted to holds, all holds name concrete cheapest tests, and excretion reasons are substantiated by embedded evidence. One major finding: the component ledger (revision 2) contradicts proposals.md revision 3 on whether skip-advice lint warnings escalate to errors under --strict — the ledger says they stay soft, the proposal says they do escalate, and the embedded wiki_sync.py:848-849 confirms the proposal's behavior. Four minor findings identify cited lines absent from the embedded section that therefore cannot be verified from this packet.
